arguments.where_clause: merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE mcc = 5311)
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant is categorised under MCC 5311 (department stores), regardless of amount, card or transaction type.
assumptions: 'Department stores' means merchants whose mcc is 5311 in the merchants table; no amount, card type or channel condition was added.
All transactions at those merchants are flagged, including negative-amount rows, which are not treated as refunds.
